en.summary: Ghana has steadied prices (5.5% inflation in October) and public finances and is now shifting to job-led growth. The 2027 budget, due in Parliament on 12 November, carries a USD 10bn 'New Economy' programme for 2027-2030. Priority sectors are commercial farming, energy, critical minerals, textiles, tourism and pharmaceuticals.
